items.title: OpenAI Reportedly Raises $11 Billion at a $1.25 Trillion Valuation
items.summary: OpenAI is reported to have secured an additional $11 billion in funding, pushing its valuation to an astounding $1.25 trillion, signaling massive investor confidence in its AI advancements.

items.title: Critical Privacy Leak: Claude Code Exposed User Email Addresses via User-Agent
items.summary: A significant privacy flaw was discovered where Claude Code inadvertently transmitted user email addresses through the User-Agent header to every website it visited, alongside a 5-month system-prompt issue.

items.title: Hundreds of Artex AI Hacking Tools Found Publicly Exposed Online
items.summary: A major security vulnerability has been uncovered, revealing hundreds of Artex AI-powered hacking tools publicly accessible on the web, posing a significant threat to cybersecurity.

items.title: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
items.summary: New research introduces SLA, a method for continually pre-training spatial-language-action models to achieve greater scalability and performance in complex AI tasks.

items.title: Google Acquires Crusoe's Troubled Wyoming Data Center Project
items.summary: Google has purchased Crusoe's problematic data center project in Wyoming, indicating a strategic move to expand its infrastructure for AI and cloud services.

items.title: OpenAI Partners with Hacktron to Enhance System Security
items.summary: OpenAI has announced a partnership with Hacktron, a cybersecurity firm, to proactively identify and mitigate vulnerabilities within its AI systems.

items.title: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents
items.summary: A new paper explores a decoupled predictive decision-making framework utilizing a shared conditional predictor to enhance the efficiency and generalization of AI agents.

items.title: Measuring AI Agents' Proficiency in Wet-Lab Science Tasks
items.summary: OpenAI is evaluating how effectively AI agents can perform and assist with practical, everyday tasks in a wet-lab scientific environment.

items.title: WeLM-Image: A Unified Image Generation Model Towards Visual Intelligence
items.summary: Researchers introduce WeLM-Image, a novel unified model designed for image generation that aims to advance visual intelligence capabilities.

items.title: Halley: A Predictive Control Plane for Optical AI Data Center Networks
items.summary: A new paper presents Halley, a predictive control plane designed to optimize optical networks within AI data centers for improved performance and efficiency.

items.title: Australian Universities Cultivating 'AI-Native' Graduates
items.summary: Australian universities are proactively integrating AI into their curricula to prepare a new generation of graduates who are inherently proficient and innovative with artificial intelligence.

items.title: TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
items.summary: TailSteer is a new technique that uses trajectory-tail steering to enable more stable and drift-resistant multi-turn image editing with AI models.

items.title: The 'Magic Pill' Delusion: Why AI Licenses Won't Fix Broken Platform Engineering
items.summary: This article argues that relying solely on AI licenses is a misguided approach and will not resolve fundamental issues within platform engineering.

items.title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
items.summary: New research proposes BestRand, a method for stable and low-cost benchmark compression, suggesting that random sampling can be highly effective for evaluating AI models.

items.title: Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge: Ghost in the Machine Winners Announced
items.summary: An update on the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge announces the winners of the 'Ghost in the Machine' category, highlighting community contributions to open-source AI.
